_about: Live settings read by every copy of the game at start and on return to the app. Edit, commit and push: the web version publishes it within minutes and the app reads it from there, no store update needed. web.latest is filled in by tools/build-www.js from package.json. Events: type 'collect' (tokens from every run, spent in the event shop); times in UTC; the shop stays open 3 days after 'end' unless 'shopEnd' is given; earn: perKill, perMinute, perBoss, win, perHall (extra share per hall index), rate multiplies all; icon: candle or bone; shop rewards: gold, gems, energy, passXp, chest (wood/silver/gold), gear { rarity 0-5 }, hero. Leaderboards ('boards', empty = none shown): { id, metric: kills|time|level|bosses|gold|wins|agony|tokens, mode: best (one fight, default) or total (added up over the period), period: all|month|week|event (with 'event': the collect event's id), optional stage, hero, win: true (victories only), start, end, name { bg, en } }. Months and weeks count in UTC; each period is a fresh board. server: true moves the profile to the game's server (functions/): every action, fight and purchase then goes through it; false keeps it on the device. ads (the Android app): rewarded and interstitial are the AdMob ad unit ids (empty: Google's test ads), verify: true makes the server pay a rewarded ad only once AdMob has confirmed it (server-side verification set up in AdMob). app: min (older app builds must update), latest (newer build announced), store (its Play Store page).

desc.bg: Докато листата падат, мъртвите палят свещи из залите. Събирай бледите им свещи и ги размени за награди, преди жътвата да свърши.
desc.en: As the leaves fall, the dead light candles through the halls. Gather their pale candles and trade them for rewards before the harvest ends.
